title: Specified modulus projection preserves the canonical boundary
statement: Fix prime ℓ and 0<r≤s, finite A killed by both powers and effective Cartier i:D→Z with both powers invertible on Z. If q:μ_(ℓ^s)→μ_(ℓ^r) satisfies the kernel inclusion equation with multiplication by ℓ^s/ℓ^r and e is the finite A-Tate-line isomorphism sending a tensor ζ to a tensor q(ζ), then the canonical pro-etale class [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class] at s postcomposed with the comparison inverse image of e equals the class at r. All Ext maps have the meaning of [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface].

source.place: Paragraph 4, exponent sentence: Kummer sequence naturality

proof.text: Put m=ℓ^s and n=ℓ^r. The given root-inclusion equation gives the morphism (q, multiplication by m/n, identity) of Kummer short exact sequences; its other square is n(m/n)=m. ShortExact.extClass_naturality identifies their positive Ext connecting classes.

source.place: Paragraph 4, exponent sentence: Kummer sequence naturality

proof.text: The pure-tensor equation at a=1 identifies the two root-to-A-line maps. Associativity of Yoneda products transports the same local pole extension witness from a normalized relative boundary at m to one at n.

source.place: Paragraph 4, exponent sentence: Kummer sequence naturality

proof.text: Uniqueness of the ordinary normalized boundary identifies its transported class with the canonical class at n. Exact comparison inverse image preserves the equation and Ext composition. The source mate is independent of the modulus, so associativity gives the required pro-etale equality.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierCanonicalClass_modulus (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (r s : ℕ) (_hr : 0 < r) (_hs : 0 < s) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (hAm : ((ℓ ^ s : ℕ) : A) = 0) (hAn : ((ℓ ^ r : ℕ) : A) = 0)
    {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hZm : IsUnit ((ℓ ^ s : ℕ) : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    (hZn : IsUnit ((ℓ ^ r : ℕ) : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    (q : Z.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ℓ ^ s) ⟶ Z.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ℓ ^ r))
    (e : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z (ℓ ^ s) A hAm ≅
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z (ℓ ^ r) A hAn)
    (hq : q ≫ kernel.ι ((ℓ ^ r) • 𝟙 Z.gmSheaf) =
      (ℓ ^ s / ℓ ^ r) • kernel.ι ((ℓ ^ s) • 𝟙 Z.gmSheaf))
    (he : ∀ (W : Z.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : A) (z : (Z.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ℓ ^ s)).obj.obj W),
      e.hom.hom.app W (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A (ℓ ^ s) Z hAm W a z) =
        Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A (ℓ ^ r) Z hAn W a (q.hom.app W z)) :
    (geoCartierCanonicalClass A (ℓ ^ s) (pow_pos hℓ.pos s) hAm i hI hZm).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).map e.hom)) (add_zero 2) =
      geoCartierCanonicalClass A (ℓ ^ r) (pow_pos hℓ.pos r) hAn i hI hZn
